furnishing.body: Everything in this dialog is ordinary content, so you can drop headings, text and buttons in here and arrange them as you like.

examples.label: Delete confirmation dialog
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-modal" site="Global" id="modal-delete-page" title="Delete this page?" size="medium" rounded="medium" show>

The page Pricing and its 3 drafts will be removed. Visitors will see your 404 page at this address until you publish something else here.

<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-delete-cancel" type="button" variant="outline" color="natural" size="small">Keep the page <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-delete-confirm" type="button" variant="default" color="danger" size="small">Delete permanently

examples.label: Newsletter signup dialog
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-modal" site="Global" id="modal-newsletter" title="Get the monthly digest" size="medium" rounded="large" show>

One email a month with new guides, release notes and the occasional field report. No sales mail, and one click unsubscribes.

<.component component_name="chelekom-label" site="Global" for="modal-newsletter-email">Email address
<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-newsletter-subscribe" type="button" variant="default" color="primary" size="small" full_width>Subscribe

We store your address only to send this digest.

examples.label: Release notes dialog
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-modal" site="Global" id="modal-release-notes" title="What changed in version 4.2" size="double_large" rounded="medium" show>

Shipped this week, and already live on your workspace.

<.component component_name="chelekom-list-group" site="Global" id="listgroup-release-items" size="small"> <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" icon="hero-sparkles" icon_class="size-4 text-amber-500">Draft previews now carry a shareable link that expires in seven days. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" icon="hero-sparkles" icon_class="size-4 text-amber-500">The media library accepts files up to 250 MB on every paid plan. <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global" padding="extra_small" icon="hero-wrench-screwdriver" icon_class="size-4 text-zinc-500">Fixed a case where reordering a list lost the last item on save.
<.component component_name="chelekom-button-link" site="Global" id="btn-release-changelog" navigate="/changelog" variant="outline" color="natural" size="small">Full changelog <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" id="btn-release-dismiss" type="button" variant="default" color="primary" size="small">Got it
